title: General Insurance
headline: Protection for the Things That Matter.
intro: Understand the cover before you choose the policy.

sections.headline: Protection for the Things That Matter.
sections.copy: General insurance protects against specified risks, subject to the policy's terms, exclusions, limits, deductibles and claim conditions. Lotus Capital can explain the options available through its insurer partners and help you with the enquiry and policy process.

sections.title: Overview
sections.copy: General insurance policies protect personal vehicles, commercial property, and enterprise assets against unexpected damage and liabilities.

sections.title: Insurer Partners
sections.copy: Policies are underwritten by confirmed partner insurers such as ICICI Lombard, HDFC ERGO, and Bajaj Allianz General Insurance.

sections.title: What to Compare
items: Claim settlement process and garage network

sections.title: How to Request a Quotation
steps: Send an enquiry or call our Godhra office.
Tell us what you want to insure and share previous policy/RC details.
We share options and quote comparisons from our insurer partners.
You review the policy terms, conditions, and exclusions before deciding.

sections.content: Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. Cover depends on the selected policy's terms, conditions, waiting periods, limits, and exclusions. Claim settlement is subject to insurer evaluation.
